question: Which two actions should be performed before upgrading the infrastructure and firmware of multiple UCS blades? (Choose two.)
options: Get Full State and All Configuration backup files before beginning the upgrade.
Verify if the bootflash on the fabric interconnects in the Cisco UCS has at least 10% available space.
Verify if the bootflash on the fabric interconnects in the Cisco UCS has at least 15% available space.
Enable Smart Call Home feature during the firmware upgrade process.
Run the Check Conformance feature to verify that all your components are running the compatible firmware version after the upgrade.
theory: Before upgrading infrastructure and blade firmware across multiple UCS servers, Cisco recommends first capturing recovery points by taking both a Full State and an All Configuration backup, so the domain can be rolled back or rebuilt if the upgrade goes wrong. Separately, the fabric interconnects' bootflash needs enough free space to stage the new firmware images during the upgrade — Cisco's guidance specifies verifying at least 15% (not 10%) free bootflash space beforehand to avoid an upgrade failing partway through due to insufficient storage. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 14 — UCS Firmware Upgrade Pre-Checks)
